(Clearing the Heavy Wood)
Working side by side, they haul a scorched counter
beam out to the curb together.
(A Shared Drink)
Sitting on two salvaged crates amidst the dust,
Maya shares a thermos of hot tea and Caleb reveals
the knee injury that ended his service.
(Hands on the Wall)
While scraping soot off the original brickwork
together, their hands brush against the same spot,
lingering as Caleb catches her eye.
(The Ceiling Cracks)
A sharp snap from the overhead joist showers
plaster between them, and Caleb steps forward to
shield Maya as the ceiling sags.
